directAnswer.en: This is repair, repointing or a small patch, not a full building frame. Particle is ≤5 mm, output 3–5 m³/h, distance 40 m horizontal / 20 m vertical. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists German type mortar spraying machine at 380 V, all-copper dual motors 7.5/9 kW, 3–5 m³/h, 8 MPa, 40 m horizontal / 20 m vertical, hose 32/38 mm, particle ≤5 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1700 × 650 × 800 mm and 360 kg. Do not move the same condition onto M9, which prints 380 V / 50 Hz, 30 L/min, 50 bar, 50 m horizontal / 20 m vertical, hose 25 mm, hopper 115 L, loading height 90 cm, particle ≤4 mm, 1230 × 720 × 1550 mm and 200 kg. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
